stem:
Leela wants an easier way to compute $48 \times 52$.

Which claims correctly rewrite the product without changing its value? Two options are correct.

options.text: $48 \times 52 = 48 + 52$, because a product means combine the two numbers by addition.

teacher.key_rationale: Difference of squares and distributivity both keep the value 2496. Replacing both factors by 50 changes the product. Addition is not multiplication.
